{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","title":"AdjacentCategoryCoefficients","description":"Fitted parameters of an adjacent-category model, every one of them a PER-STEP quantity.","type":"object","properties":{"coefficients":{"description":"One coefficient per feature, shared by every adjacent pair of levels. `exp(value)` is the
factor one unit of that feature applies to the odds of landing on level `k + 1` rather than
on level `k`, and it is the same factor at every `k`. It is NOT the cumulative odds ratio a
proportional-odds fit reports: do not compare the two numbers directly.","type":"array","items":{"type":"number","format":"double"}},"n_features":{"description":"Number of input features.","type":"integer","format":"uint","minimum":0},"level_contrasts":{"description":"The `n_levels - 1` fitted level contrasts, lowest pair first: entry `k` is the log odds of

level is rarer than the one below it, and forcing an order on them would be wrong here.","type":"array","items":{"type":"number","format":"double"}},"n_levels":{"description":"Number of ordered levels the model was fitted on.","type":"integer","format":"uint","minimum":0},"bottom_to_top_effect":{"description":"`(n_levels - 1) * coefficient`: the total log-odds effect of one unit of each feature across
